description: This file defines a set of CMake functions and callbacks for serializing and deserializing JSON data structures within a CMake build system, including handling objects, arrays, key-value pairs, and literals.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function to process JSON data with callbacks for building the result.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to start a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to end a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to process the beginning of a key-value pair in an object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to process the end of a key-value pair, adding comma if needed.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to process the end of an array element, adding comma if needed.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals like null, booleans, numbers, or strings.
